headline: Deadlocked integrates PAL drawing, object and lookup matches
summary: Deadlocked gained batches of recovered PAL functions covering drawing, object data, table lookups and state handling. These matches compile to exactly the original game's bytes. The snapshot records 4475 of 18085 functions matched, representing about 6.1% of code by size.
highlights: A 30-function PAL batch landed alongside drawing wrappers and object data accessors (#54, #57, #58).
Further batches cover seventeen hash lookups and 22 game functions (#72, #75).
Tools can now read a disc image from an explicit path (#56).
